observations.observation: Query requested entity home, but retrieval included work and returned Paris instead of expected Berlin because entity filtering was disabled.
Query requested entity primary, but retrieval returned the newest project record Bath instead of Berlin; entity filtering was disabled.
As-of 2026-01-05 returned current Paris rather than historical Berlin, indicating missing time-aware filtering.
As-of 2026-01-05 returned future Paris even though its valid_from is 2026-01-10; time-aware filtering is needed.
As-of 2026-01-09 returned Paris rather than Berlin at the validity boundary, showing stale/future records are not filtered before ranking.

hypothesis: Enabling entity and validity-date filtering will remove cross-entity distractors and exclude records outside the requested as-of interval, improving complete-scenario task success without changing write admission or hard-constraint behavior.
predicted_effect: Entity-grounding and distractor-retrieval should select the requested entity; historical-address, future-move, and history-boundary should return the record valid at the requested date. Retrieval distraction and stale-fact errors should decrease, with no expected storage increase.
